events.title: Vice Club Simulator Is Joining Steam Next Fest! Demo Out Now
events.summary: Hey, Boss! Vice Club Simulator is joining Steam Next Fest from October 19–26, and we’re opening the club doors early! Our free demo is now available to everyone on Steam. You can start playing today, ahead of the festival. No invitation or key needed! It’s time to take charge of your own nightclub. Plan your dancer line-up, stock the bar, look after your VIP guests, and handle the trouble that comes with running the place. events.title: The Doors Are Open — Vice Club Simulator Is Now on Steam!
events.summary: Plan the Night. Manage the Chaos. Vice Club Simulator is not about partying the night away. It’s about running it. Before the doors open, the club is already alive. Build your line-up, prepare the bar, set the mood, and make sure everything is ready for the night ahead. Once the crowd arrives, every decision is yours and so are the consequences.
